description: OYH R-100 is a new-generation, environmentally friendly polycarboxylate ether (PCE) superplasticizer. Synthesized through the polymerization of polyether macromonomers and acrylic acid, the product delivers outstanding performance characteristics, including high water-reduction efficiency, excellent slump retention, low chloride ion content, low alkali content, and superior environmental compatibility.
whereToUse: Concrete containing high volumes of supplementary cementitious materials
Grouting materials and self-leveling mortar systems
advantages: has a high water reduction rate
improves both early strength and final strength
Improves slump retention over extended periods
Reduces the rate of hydration heat release, helping minimize thermal cracking risks
Enhances fracture toughness and long-term durability of concrete
Contributes to the production of more sustainable and environmentally friendly concrete systems
notFor: the product is intended for further processing and compounding and is not recommended for direct use in concrete applications without proper formulation adjustment
OYH R-100 must not be mixed with naphthalene-based superplasticizers
all mixers, pipelines, and transit mixers previously exposed to naphthalene-based admixtures should be thoroughly cleaned

technicalData.label: Recommended dosage (by weight of cementitious materials)

consumption.quote: The recommended dosage of OYH R-100 is 0.25%-0.85% by weight of cementitious materials.
The optimum dosage should be determined through laboratory and field testing according to specific project requirements, raw materials, and mix design conditions.

mixing: OYH R-100 may be introduced together with the mixing water or added simultaneously into the concrete mixer during batching. To ensure optimal dispersion and water-reducing performance, a minimum mixing time of 120 seconds is recommended.
packaging: Upon your request, flexible tanks, 1000 L IBCs, are available.
storage: Minimum shelf life of 12 months, which should be avoided from direct sunlight, and is stored in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 5 °C and 50 °C.
